title: The Avalanche Bell
text: A bell hangs over the pass to warn of avalanches, its rope frozen stiff as iron. Above it the snow leans out over the cliffs, heavy and blue and listening. One loud word could bring it all down.

outcomes.text: The snow comes down behind you like the end of the world, and buries whatever was following.

options.label: Creep through in silence, under the leaning snow.

outcomes.text: Not a flake falls. Not a breath is heard. You come out the other side shaking.

options.label: The strongest cuts the bell down and takes it.

outcomes.text: Old bronze, very heavy, very valuable, and the pass has no warning now for whoever comes next.
